svg.title: Build an Auditable Domain Desk in Thirty Days
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-domain-launch; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Build an Auditable Domain Desk in Thirty Days; subtitle: Four weekly milestones establish operations, not a promised sale.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The launch sprint creates evidence, controls, and listings. Canonical first-deal timing remains 2–9 months. Buying inventory during the sprint is conditional on completed diligence and available carrying reserves.; caption: Exit day 30 with documented buy rules, controlled inventory, working inquiry routing, and a renewal calendar; report actual offers and settlements separately from asking prices.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define the thesis and capital limits; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one primary niche, document buyer use cases, build a comparable-sales worksheet, allocate startup cash, and set per-name and portfolio bid ceilings.; label: Days 8-14; value: Complete diligence and secure operating accounts; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Record trademark and historical-use checks, review auction terms, enable registrar multifactor authentication, and create dated acquisition decisions before placing authorized bids.; label: Days 15-21; value: Publish controlled inventory and route inquiries; numeric value: 21.0; detail: List only owned names, synchronize venue prices, test contact routing, maintain opt-out suppression, and verify escrow and transfer procedures without initiating a test ownership transfer.; label: Days 22-30; value: Audit unit economics and the renewal runway; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile actual spending, inspect qualified inquiries, calculate transaction-level contribution, schedule 90-, 60-, and 30-day renewal reminders, and define next-month retain-or-drop decisions.

text.tspan: Build an Auditable Domain Desk in Thirty Days

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define the thesis and capital limits; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one primary niche, document buyer use cases, build a comparable-sales worksheet, allocate startup cash, and set per-name and portfolio bid ceilings.

text.title: Define the thesis and capital limits
text.tspan: Define the thesis and capital limits

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Complete diligence and secure operating accounts; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Record trademark and historical-use checks, review auction terms, enable registrar multifactor authentication, and create dated acquisition decisions before placing authorized bids.

text.title: Complete diligence and secure operating accounts

rect.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Publish controlled inventory and route inquiries; numeric value: 21.0; detail: List only owned names, synchronize venue prices, test contact routing, maintain opt-out suppression, and verify escrow and transfer procedures without initiating a test ownership transfer.

text.title: Publish controlled inventory and route inquiries

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Audit unit economics and the renewal runway; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile actual spending, inspect qualified inquiries, calculate transaction-level contribution, schedule 90-, 60-, and 30-day renewal reminders, and define next-month retain-or-drop decisions.
